notes: Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mousedown + mouseup + click / mousewheel / mouseout from outside the canvas; each 10 ms after the last; a frame of every chart after every step.
TooltipRichContent.getSize answers 80 x 40; box is the moveTo argument.
The axis pointer's own highlight / downplay batches (notBlur, escapeConnect) are not listened to.

cases.note: two charts of one shape, an axis tooltip, connected: A's pointer and B following through updateAxisPointer (B's point from findPointFromSeries), then the three actions dispatched by hand on A -- showTip by seriesIndex + dataIndex (the axis detour), hideTip, showTip at x / y, updateAxisPointer at x / y, by seriesIndex + dataIndex with axesInfo, a payload position, an escapeConnect showTip that stays in A

two charts of one shape, an item tooltip, connected: A over a bar and over a line symbol (B shows the item at findPointFromSeries, the box below the element), off them; showTip by seriesIndex + dataIndex, by name, with a position word; hideTip

three connected charts of different shapes: A five categories; B four categories and two series (its own series 0 places the point: past its last row there is no point, so nothing); C two grids -- a pointer in its second names series 1, which A does not have
A two grids linked {xAxisIndex: all}, B one grid, connected: A's event lists both axes, B takes x0
alwaysShowContent: a leave, a hideTip and a move off the grid leave the box up; the pointer goes
triggerOn click|mousewheel, connected: a move is silent (neither listener hears it), a click on a bar and a wheel drive both, a leave hides
triggerOn none: the pointer drives nothing; showTip and hideTip still work

enterable, item: the pointer goes into the box's blank corner -- the richText content is hit on its glyph runs only, so the pointer is over the ground beneath and the hide is armed as without enterable
showDelay 50 and hideDelay 300 in both charts of a group: the shows wait in A and in B
value axes with a cross pointer, connected: the event's axesInfo carries both arms; B takes both values

by hand on one chart: showTip with a written dataByCoordSys, a leave through updateAxisPointer, showTip at a point off the grid, updateAxisPointer with axesInfo alone (no point: everything hides), showTip by seriesIndex alone

B has two x axes in one grid (the top one with its own series) and a third series whose own tooltip says item: it never joins an axis tooltip; A's axesInfo names x0 only, so B's x1 stays down though the point is in its grid
A without a tooltip component (the axis pointer's triggerOn is then mousemove|click|mousewheel), B with one: A's moves and its wheel publish updateAxisPointer and hideTip, B follows
